passages.text: Then Miriam and Aaron criticized Moses because of the Cushite woman he had married, for he had taken a Cushite wife.
passages.sermon:
Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses.
They criticized Moses.
They did this because of the Cushite woman.
Moses had married a Cushite woman.
Moses had taken her as his wife.
passages.original: וַתְּדַבֵּ֨ר מִרְיָ֤ם וְאַהֲרֹן֙ בְּמֹשֶׁ֔ה עַל־ אֹד֛וֹת הָאִשָּׁ֥ה הַכֻּשִׁ֖ית אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָקָ֑ח כִּֽי־ אִשָּׁ֥ה כֻשִׁ֖ית לָקָֽח׃

passages.text: “Does the LORD speak only through Moses?” they said. “Does He not also speak through us?” And the LORD heard this.
passages.sermon:
Miriam and Aaron spoke.
They questioned Moses’ special role.
They said, “Does the LORD speak only through Moses?”
They asked, “Does the LORD also speak through us?”
The LORD heard what they said.
passages.original: וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ הֲרַ֤ק אַךְ־ בְּמֹשֶׁה֙ דִּבֶּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הֲלֹ֖א גַּם־ בָּ֣נוּ דִבֵּ֑ר וַיִּשְׁמַ֖ע יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Now Moses was a very humble man, more so than any man on the face of the earth.
passages.sermon: Moses was a man.\r\nMoses was very humble.\r\nMoses was more humble than any other person on earth.
passages.original: וְהָאִ֥ישׁ מֹשֶׁ֖ה עָנָו מְאֹ֑ד מִכֹּל֙ הָֽאָדָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָֽה׃ס

passages.text: And suddenly the LORD said to Moses, Aaron, and Miriam, “You three, come out to the Tent of Meeting.” So the three went out, and the LORD came down in a pillar of cloud, stood at the entrance to the Tent, and summoned Aaron and Miriam. When both of them had stepped forward, He said, “Hear now My words: If there is a prophet among you, I, the LORD, will reveal Myself to him in a vision; I will speak to him in a dream.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke suddenly to Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.
He said, “You three, come out to the Tent of Meeting.”
Moses, Aaron, and Miriam went out together.
The LORD came down in a pillar of cloud.
He stood at the entrance to the Tent.
The LORD called for Aaron and Miriam.
Aaron and Miriam stepped forward.
The LORD said, “Listen to My words.
If there is a prophet among you, I, the LORD, will make Myself known to him in a vision.
I will speak to him in a dream.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה פִּתְאֹ֗ם אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֤ה וְאֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹן֙ וְאֶל־ מִרְיָ֔ם צְא֥וּ שְׁלָשְׁתְּכֶ֖ם אֶל־ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וַיֵּצְא֖וּ שְׁלָשְׁתָּֽם׃ וַיֵּ֤רֶד יְהוָה֙ בְּעַמּ֣וּד עָנָ֔ן וַֽיַּעֲמֹ֖ד פֶּ֣תַח הָאֹ֑הֶל וַיִּקְרָא֙ אַהֲרֹ֣ן וּמִרְיָ֔ם וַיֵּצְא֖וּ שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃ וַיֹּ֖אמֶר שִׁמְעוּ־ נָ֣א דְבָרָ֑י אִם־ יִֽהְיֶה֙ נְבִ֣יאֲכֶ֔ם יְהוָ֗ה בַּמַּרְאָה֙ אֵלָ֣יו אֶתְוַדָּ֔ע בַּחֲל֖וֹם אֲדַבֶּר־ בּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: But this is not so with My servant Moses; he is faithful in all My house.
passages.sermon:
Moses is my servant.
Moses is not like the others.
Moses is faithful.
Moses is faithful in all my house.
passages.original: לֹא־ כֵ֖ן עַבְדִּ֣י מֹשֶׁ֑ה בְּכָל־ בֵּיתִ֖י נֶאֱמָ֥ן הֽוּא׃

passages.text: I speak with him face to face, clearly and not in riddles; he sees the form of the LORD. Why then were you unafraid to speak against My servant Moses?”
passages.sermon:
God spoke about Moses.
God said, “I speak with Moses face to face.
I speak to him clearly.
I do not speak to him in riddles.
Moses sees the form of the LORD.
Why were you not afraid to speak against My servant Moses?”
passages.original: פֶּ֣ה אֶל־ פֶּ֞ה אֲדַבֶּר־ בּ֗וֹ וּמַרְאֶה֙ וְלֹ֣א בְחִידֹ֔ת וּתְמֻנַ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה יַבִּ֑יט וּמַדּ֙וּעַ֙ לֹ֣א יְרֵאתֶ֔ם לְדַבֵּ֖ר בְּעַבְדִּ֥י בְמֹשֶֽׁה׃

passages.text: So the anger of the LORD burned against them, and He departed.
passages.sermon: The LORD became very angry with them.\r\nHe left them.

passages.text: As the cloud lifted from above the Tent, suddenly Miriam became leprous, white as snow. Aaron turned toward her, saw that she was leprous, and said to Moses, “My lord, please do not hold against us this sin we have so foolishly committed.
passages.sermon:
God punished Miriam and Aaron for speaking against Moses.
God showed His anger by making Miriam leprous.
The cloud lifted from above the Tent.
Miriam suddenly became leprous.
Her skin was white as snow.
Aaron turned and looked at Miriam.
He saw that she was leprous.
Aaron spoke to Moses.
He said, “My lord, please do not hold this sin against us.
We have acted foolishly.
We have sinned.”
passages.original: וְהֶעָנָ֗ן סָ֚ר מֵעַ֣ל הָאֹ֔הֶל וְהִנֵּ֥ה מִרְיָ֖ם מְצֹרַ֣עַת כַּשָּׁ֑לֶג וַיִּ֧פֶן אַהֲרֹ֛ן אֶל־ מִרְיָ֖ם וְהִנֵּ֥ה מְצֹרָֽעַת׃ וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אַהֲרֹ֖ן אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֑ה בִּ֣י אֲדֹנִ֔י אַל־ נָ֨א תָשֵׁ֤ת עָלֵ֙ינוּ֙ חַטָּ֔את אֲשֶׁ֥ר נוֹאַ֖לְנוּ וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטָֽאנוּ׃

passages.text: Please do not let her be like a stillborn infant whose flesh is half consumed when he comes out of his mother’s womb.”
passages.sermon:
Aaron spoke to Moses.
Aaron pleaded for Miriam.
Aaron said, “Please do not let Miriam be like a dead child.
Do not let her be like a stillborn baby.
A stillborn baby comes out of his mother’s womb.
Half of his flesh is already eaten away.
Do not let Miriam suffer like this.”
passages.original: אַל־ נָ֥א תְהִ֖י כַּמֵּ֑ת אֲשֶׁ֤ר בְּצֵאתוֹ֙ מֵרֶ֣חֶם אִמּ֔וֹ וַיֵּאָכֵ֖ל חֲצִ֥י בְשָׂרֽוֹ׃

passages.text: So Moses cried out to the LORD, “O God, please heal her!”
passages.sermon:
Moses was a prophet and leader of Israel.
Miriam was his sister.
Miriam became leprous.
Moses saw her sickness.
Moses cried out to the LORD.
He said, “O God, please heal her.”
passages.original: וַיִּצְעַ֣ק מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר אֵ֕ל נָ֛א רְפָ֥א נָ֖א לָֽהּ׃פ

passages.text: But the LORD answered Moses, “If her father had but spit in her face, would she not have been in disgrace for seven days? Let her be confined outside the camp for seven days; after that she may be brought back in.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD said, “Suppose her father spit in her face.
She would feel shame for seven days.
She must stay outside the camp for seven days.
After seven days, she can return.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֗ה וְאָבִ֙יהָ֙ יָרֹ֤ק יָרַק֙ בְּפָנֶ֔יהָ הֲלֹ֥א תִכָּלֵ֖ם שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים תִּסָּגֵ֞ר שִׁבְעַ֤ת יָמִים֙ מִח֣וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וְאַחַ֖ר תֵּאָסֵֽף׃

passages.text: So Miriam was confined outside the camp for seven days, and the people did not move on until she was brought in again.
passages.sermon:
Miriam was a leader among the Israelites.
Miriam became unclean and had to leave the camp.
She stayed outside the camp for seven days.
The people of Israel did not travel during this time.
They waited until Miriam returned to the camp.
passages.original: וַתִּסָּגֵ֥ר מִרְיָ֛ם מִח֥וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֖ה שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים וְהָעָם֙ לֹ֣א נָסַ֔ע עַד־ הֵאָסֵ֖ף מִרְיָֽם׃

passages.text: After that, the people set out from Hazeroth and camped in the Wilderness of Paran.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites were God's chosen people.
They left the place called Hazeroth.
They traveled together.
They stopped and camped in the Wilderness of Paran.
passages.original: וְאַחַ֛ר נָסְע֥וּ הָעָ֖ם מֵחֲצֵר֑וֹת וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּמִדְבַּ֥ר פָּארָֽן׃פ
